Title: Azure Data Lake Storage static website is now generally available

Body.Content:
Static website for Azure Data Lake Storage is now generally available. Use static website to directly host static content from Azure Data Lake Storage and view that site content from a browser by using the public URL of that website. 

To learn more, please read the documentation on static website.   

Enabling static website hosting is free of charge. Storage usage and transactions will be billed as normal. To learn more about pricing, visit the Azure Data Lake Storage pricing page.
